There are a number of sources of freely licensed and public domain images on the Web.
The presence of a resource on this list does not guarantee that all or any of the images in it are freely licensed and/or in the public domain: you are still responsible for checking the copyright status of images before you submit them to Wikipedia.
See also
Wikipedia:Public domain image resources
Search engines
Openverse (formerly CC Search) allows you to search across many sources of freely licensed images and animations, including many, but not yet all, of the ones listed here. You can filter by licenses and types, including image type "photographs".
General collections
Flickr ( free search ) – Flickr is a big photo sharing website. It has many pictures licenced with Creative Commons Attribution License and Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License . ( Search both )
Beware that Flickr is a problematic source – many images are acceptable, but many are not. See details on Flickr below .
Crowdsource – 400,000 CC-BY pictures mostly from underrepresented countries.
LookAndLearn.com – 1,000,000+ Free Historical Public Domain Images curated from Public Collections.
Snappygoat.com – 13,990,108 Free Public Domain/CC0 Images from multiple sources. Single search for images from Wikipedia Commons, Pixabay, Flickr, British Library, NYPL and others. Full image downloads without login or restrictions. Includes a meme maker.
Pixnio – A large collection of high resolution public domain images. Free for personal and commercial use, no attribution required.
Dreamstime CC0 Stock Photos – A large selection of over 2 million public domain (CC0) and free stock photos. Curated, model & non model-released photos.
LibreShot.com – photos in high resolution for free use even commercialy (Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain License).
WPclipart – Public domain clip art and photographs, student-safe but expansive.
Skitterphoto – Authentic public domain photos. Updated daily, all images creative commons CC0. No registration.
Agência Brasil – official agency of the Brasilian government, has pictures of Brasilian officials, including on official trips and meeting foreign dignitaries (use {{Agência Brasil| photo number }} template). Does not apply to content produced after 23 February 2017.
Archive.org compendium of Illustrations in the Public Domain - 300-page book.
Digital documents from the Bibliothèque Nationale de France (BNF). (website is in French).
BurningWell.org – PD according to terms .
Gnu art – Media by GNU GPL licence.
Project Gutenberg – 12,000+ books, only a few illustrated, but the number of illustrated books increases from week to week. There are thousands upon thousands of PD images to be had, with a wee bit of legwork and a modicum of serendipity.

Category:Commons resources
Banknotes and coins
http://www.currencymuseum.net - Lots of images of banknotes from all over the world, all scanned at a standard 150 dpi. Use {{PD-banknote}} and an appropriate tag for the country from en:Category:Currency copyright tags .
http://aes.iupui.edu/rwise - A huge number of banknote images from all over the world. Use {{PD-banknote}} and an appropriate tag for the country from en:Category:Currency copyright tags
http://worldcoingallery.com/ - Permission given by mail to Wikipedia (OTRS ticket number 2006080810014758). Contains all sorts of coins images all over the world, licensed under the GFDL. Use {{WorldCoinGallery}} and an appropriate tag for the country from en:Category:Currency copyright tags .
Geography
http://www.geograph.org.uk/ - Photographs from all over the UK, Isle of Man, and Ireland, all are licensed under CC-BY-SA-2.0.
General collections
1010CliptArt - Over 100,000 free SVG clipart Graphics.
PikWizard.com - Over 1,000,000 stock of free images and videos, all of which are royalty-free and safe for commercial use, with no attribution required.

Motosha - Free and premium stock photos.
